Miyoo Friends Library
PrivacyTerms

Last updated: 14 November 2026

Usage terms

Miyoo Friends Library is a lightweight personal-use tool for browsing a private library and downloading selected files.

Permitted use

Access only Google accounts and folders you are authorized to use. Share and download only files you are legally entitled to share and use. The application does not grant any copyright license to games or BIOS files. Respect Google Drive's service terms and other participants' permissions.

Your account and device

Each person uses their own Google account and authorization. Protect your microSD card and credentials. Do not redistribute another person's account configuration. Back up important files and maintain enough free space for downloads.

Compatibility and availability

The current target is Miyoo Mini Plus running OnionOS 4.3. This is a community application; compatibility with other devices or operating-system versions is not promised. Network access, Google authorization, API availability and folder permissions can change. Continuous access and uninterrupted transfers are not guaranteed.

Software and third-party components

The installation package includes the application's license and notices for rclone and other bundled components. Those licenses govern the software they cover. The application is provided under its accompanying license, including its warranty provisions.

Privacy and support

See the privacy policy for Google data access, storage and disconnection. Contact the friend who supplied the package for support. This website is informational; it provides no public game hosting or download service.
